# Scope

This file is a reproducible report scaffold for the project. It is not the
manuscript draft; the user explicitly deferred manuscript writing. The build
pipeline instead renders public-safe manifests, table inventories, and figure
links so the empirical package can be audited before prose is written.

# Research Question

Do point-in-time bank balance-sheet duration exposure and deposit-franchise
fragility define a priced, state-dependent source of expected return in U.S.
bank equities?

# Reproducibility Contract

- Regulatory features are activated only after the configured public-information
  lag.
- Raw WRDS data and licensed extracts are never committed.
- Headline metrics must come from walk-forward out-of-sample predictions.
- Visuals are checked both by automated audit and by manual inspection before
  public release.

# Generated Outputs

The `make paper` target writes an HTML report from
`data_manifest/full_live_public_summary.json` when full-run artifacts are
available.
